subject: HEAVY TAKE lowering-air-opus: native rebuild for the iOS strict link (build_native_compilers.py air, then mali with -DTEGU_MALI_AIR)
body: host gates with TEGU_AIR_DIRECT=0 are green up to the iOS strict link, which needs the new tegu_air_library_air_source in the iOS Rust staticlib and the AIR objects in libNord2Mali.a.
